SELECT 
  MIN(an.name) AS voicing_actress,
  MIN(t.title) AS kung_fu_panda
FROM 
  aka_name an
  INNER JOIN char_name chn ON an.person_id = chn.id
  INNER JOIN cast_info ci ON an.person_id = ci.person_id AND ci.role_id = (SELECT id FROM role_type WHERE role = 'actress')
  INNER JOIN company_name cn ON cn.id = ci.movie_id
  INNER JOIN info_type it ON it.id = mi.info_type_id
  INNER JOIN movie_companies mc ON mc.movie_id = t.id
  INNER JOIN movie_info mi ON mi.movie_id = t.id AND mi.info_type_id = it.id
  INNER JOIN name n ON n.id = ci.person_id
  INNER JOIN title t ON t.id = mc.movie_id
WHERE 
  ci.note = '(voice)'
  AND cn.country_code ='[us]'
  AND it.info = 'release dates'
  AND mc.note LIKE '%(200%)%'
  AND (mc.note LIKE '%(USA)%' OR mc.note LIKE '%(worldwide)%')
  AND mi.info IS NOT NULL
  AND (mi.info LIKE 'Japan:%2007%' OR mi.info LIKE 'USA:%2008%')
  AND n.gender ='f'
  AND n.name LIKE '%Angel%'
  AND t.production_year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2008
  AND t.title LIKE '%Kung%Fu%Panda%'
